Bhopal Metro:
The Bhopal Metro is being constructed with a total length of 104.87 km across 6 corridors, with the first phase covering 28 km and 28 stations. Estimated cost is approximately $960 million.
Meerut Metro:
The Meerut Metro will be developed in two phases, with the first phase covering 23.6 km from Modipuram to Meerut South, featuring 12 stations.
Patna Metro:
The Patna Metro will have 2 lines totaling 41.66 km with 26 stations, developed under a public-private partnership model.
